data.title: D · 新婚卧榻的白丝睡袍独白
data.description: 静谧卧室内只有床头一盏泛黄的小台灯亮着。D身穿纯白色的半透真丝晨袍坐在床沿，黑色短斧静静藏在床头柜暗格。她解开晨袍系带，露出雪白精致的锁骨与腰线，双手交叠放在膝头。杀手冰冷的防备在这一刻彻底消融，红眸深情地仰望着你，仿佛在无声诉说着愿将灵魂托付的誓约。
data.location: intimate sunlit bedroom with billowing sheer curtains

data.promptProse: Sitting quietly on the edge of the bed inside an intimate bedroom, D wears a bridal-white translucent silk peignoir edged with scalloped French lace parted softly at the collar. Her unguarded purple eyes meet the viewer with calm, heartfelt devotion under soft amber bedside lamplight.
data.animaCaption: Seated quietly on the edge of the bed in a sheer bridal-white lace-trimmed silk peignoir parted softly at the collar, she gazes toward the viewer with unguarded, gentle devotion. Warm amber bedside lamplight casts long soft shadows across the billowing curtains.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a translucent bridal-white silk peignoir edged with scalloped French lace, draped loosely open at the collar over bare shoulders.
